technical.summary: Mixed technical setup with strong trend confirmation (ADX, Supertrend, Hull) but conflicting moving average structure and price below key EMAs limits conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: KMX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 57 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (28/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is absent and news data unavailable, limiting conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (372.96) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; 57-day earnings window adds moderate event risk for discretionary consumer stock.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX strong + Supertrend bullish + Hull bullish provide trend confirmation, and extreme VIX fear (28/100) creates contrarian opportunity near support at 106.91.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all key EMAs (9, 20, 21, 50) and SMA 50, Ichimoku below cloud, negative AO, low volume ratio (0.63), zero fundamental conviction (insider/institutional), high earnings risk in 57 days, and macro crisis VIX regime (372.96) overwhelm technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: While ADX/Supertrend/Hull confirm uptrend and extreme VIX fear creates contrarian opportunity, price remains below all key moving averages with negative momentum (AO, OBV) and zero fundamental conviction, making risk/reward unfavorable.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 57 days combined with macro crisis VIX regime (372.96) and price below EMA structure creates elevated drawdown risk for discretionary consumer stock in fear-driven market.
